name: Anion Class App
summary: Anion is live on Cloudflare with Google-only login, but it is not yet production-ready. The immediate auth blocker is missing public Supabase environment configuration in production, alongside incomplete Stripe/Daily setup, blocked authenticated evidence, and open legal/monitoring sign-off.

metrics.label: Docs
metrics.detail: Product, architecture, ADR, status docs, CLIENT-HANDOVER.md, PRIVACY.md, TERMS.md, DISASTER-RECOVERY.md, MONITORING-ALERTS.md, and PRODUCTION-READINESS.md are in place.

metrics.label: Web Lane
metrics.detail: Core surfaces are deployed live, but the current production login path is blocked because the public Supabase auth env vars are not available to the browser runtime, and auth/roles, bookings, and classroom flows are not yet re-verified after the Google-only auth switch.

metrics.label: Database
metrics.detail: All seventeen migrations applied to live Supabase project (foundation, auth-rls, bookings, subscriptions, security hardening, webhook events, classroom posts, student booking access, parent-student link RLS, parent linked-student visibility, booking student assignment, related profile visibility, tutor assigned-student visibility, parent-name visibility for related users, tutor-name visibility for families, classroom post student scoping, classroom post parent and admin timeline access).

metrics.label: Live Runtime
metrics.detail: Cloudflare deployment is live, but `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and/or `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` are currently missing in the browser runtime, and Stripe live keys, Daily API config, Supabase auth allow-list confirmation, and authenticated Phase 1 verification are still blocking full production sign-off.

metrics.label: Trust Docs
metrics.detail: PRIVACY.md and TERMS.md created as implementation-ready placeholders awaiting legal review before publication.

checks.name: TypeScript
checks.detail: The primary Anion workspace has passed type-check/build previously, but the clean release worktree needs dependency install reconciliation before `npm run ci:check` is reproducible there.

checks.name: Next.js build
checks.detail: Current live deployment is healthy, but committed source required status/auth doc reconciliation and the clean release worktree has not yet reproduced a full passing `ci:check`.

checks.name: Git commits
checks.detail: Two commits: 21e45561 (M1-M2) and 39e6dc32 (M3-M5). Ready to push.

checks.name: Client handover
checks.detail: ops/CLIENT-HANDOVER.md now reflects Google OAuth auth and current external blocker checklist for Stripe, Daily, Supabase, and Cloudflare.

checks.name: Privacy & Terms
checks.detail: docs/PRIVACY.md and docs/TERMS.md created as placeholders. Legal review required before publication.

checks.name: Disaster recovery
checks.detail: ops/DISASTER-RECOVERY.md documents RTO/RPO targets, backup strategy, restore runbooks, and incident response.

checks.name: Monitoring & alerts
checks.detail: ops/MONITORING-ALERTS.md is updated for Google OAuth, but actual uptime/alert destinations are still placeholders and need to be configured.

checks.name: Production readiness
checks.detail: ops/PRODUCTION-READINESS.md is the consolidated go-live checklist, but several external config, functional smoke, security, legal, and ops gates remain unsigned.

Complete the remaining PRODUCTION-READINESS.md external blocker checklist — configure Stripe live keys, Daily API key/domain, Supabase domain allow-list, and confirm Cloudflare env vars/secrets.

Obtain legal review and sign-off on docs/PRIVACY.md and docs/TERMS.md before publishing to users.
